text:
alex (PM): quick check — we need to recalibrate RICE for Q4. biggest asks: observability for dedicated customers vs infra perf work. can we discuss sequencing?

maria (Eng Lead): +1. infra perf needs runway. if we roll observability first we risk throughput regressions during peak.

sam (Data): data: last 30d dedicated qps up 35%; customer-reported incidents up 8%. rough impact estimate: observability could reduce ops toil by ~40% for top 5 accounts.

devin (ProdOps): sequencing idea: ship a lightweight telemetry probe first (no UI) -> reduces toil and buys time for full UI. can this be a small slice?

katie (Design): lightweight probe ok, but we need clear acceptance criteria. UI can be phased. smaller ship keeps effort low.

alex (PM): thinking RICE tilt: keep Reach & Impact, but de-emphasize Confidence for early infra bets — it penalizes novel infra work too much. open to changing weights 3/3/2/2 -> 4/3/1/2? thoughts?

sam (Data): anchoring bias warning — we've been giving infra low impact historically. recommend we re-run scoring with blinded titles (no label) and rely on metrics. I'll run it.

maria (Eng Lead): agree with blinded scoring. also, effort estimates vary a lot. can we split infra into 'probe' (2w) + 'scale' (6w) to reflect sequencing?

alex (PM): good. propose: 1) blind scores from Sam, 2) split tickets (probe vs scale), 3) weight Reach x2, Impact x1.5, Confidence x1. keep Effort as divisor. quick vote: :thumbsup: for plan?

katie (Design): :thumbsup: for phased approach

devin (ProdOps): :thumbsup:

maria (Eng Lead): :thumbsup: but we need a gating checklist for probe to ensure it surfaces the right signals.

prio-bot: action created — task #4523 "Run blinded RICE scoring + split infra probes" assigned to sam, due in 3d

alex (PM): thanks all. Sam — ping when scores done and drop CSV. We'll use results to finalize Q4 slice at Thursday sync.

sam (Data): on it. I'll post blinded CSV + simple calc snippet:
```
# score calc
score = (reach * impact * confidence) / effort
```

alex (PM): perfect. if anyone has anecdotal account stories that affect reach, DM me (don't include labels in scoring).
